photos.desc: Is a large forest bird endemic to the Philippines. It is one of the 11 endemic hornbills in the country. It is only found in Palawan and nearby islands of Balabac, Busuanga, Calauit, Culion and Coron.

Palawan Hornbill (Anthracoceros marchei) is a large, black-and-white hornbill with a prominent casque, endemic to Palawan, usually found in primary forests where it feeds on fruits, berries, and small
he Palawan hornbill consumes mostly fruit, but also occasional insects and vertebrates. Due to its large size and home range.
